text:
alex: Heads-up: sketching a "route cost snapshot" API for console. Goal: single-call per-route+time-window that returns token-cost, cache-savings, model-sku split, and fallback-charge. Want thoughts before I wire.

tess: ooh yes — needed for rollout previews. Do we include sampling bias / confidence interval?

sam: +1 include CI. also need sample-rate metadata and raw counts, otherwise ppl will misinterpret.

jin: how about attribution for shared prefetch cache? need rules for splitting credits across routes that hit same prefetched tokens.

alex: proposal: attach "prefetch_credits" field with breakdown by route based on last-touch within session. quick prototype returns deterministic last-touch heuristic.

tess: last-touch is simpler but gaming risk. can we surface algorithm version and allow switch in console?

sam: agree surface algo version and sample size. Also add a field "unit": "token" and "model_sku" list with cost per token.

alex: sample payload:

```
{
  "route": "/api/chat",
  "window": "2026-03-18T00:00:00Z/2026-03-18T01:00:00Z",
  "total_tokens": 123456,
  "net_cost_usd": 12.34,
  "cache_savings_usd": 3.21,
  "model_breakdown": [{"sku":"rwintra-8g","tokens":100000,"cost":10.0},{"sku":"gpt-small","tokens":23456,"cost":2.34}],
  "prefetch_credits": [{"route":"/api/qa","usd":1.5},{"route":"/api/chat","usd":1.71}],
  "confidence": 0.95,
  "algo_version": "v0.3-last-touch"
}
```

jin: looks good. what about quotas? need to show quota burn vs billable tokens (dedicated reserved vs overage).

tess: yes include "quota_consumed_tokens" and "billable_tokens" fields.

sam: and show "routing_policy_applied" for this window so we can correlate canary cost spikes.

alex: added. Also we need fast API for console — maybe precompute hourly snapshots and cache them for 5-10m; on-demand compute should fallback async.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: cost-snapshot-service -> canary on infra-pp, 10% traffic at 15:00 UTC.

tess: UX ask: add "explain" link to expand per-request sample rows (only 10 lines). we can link to raw telemetry.

alex: sounds good. I'll push a PR with the proto and feature-flagged API. Can we get review from eng-ml for attribution logic?

sam: ping jin for review? :thumbsup:

jin: will review attribution heuristics tomorrow. quick note: log format needs last_touch_session_id + prefetched_token_id to validate split.

alex: thanks all. filing a ticket: RH-5432 with specs and sample payload. I'll post PR link when ready.
